title: Paywall Heart
lessons: three scores stay free; the meaning rents
your nights are yours — their graphs never quite were

intro.speaker: OURA
text: Good evening. Overnight: asleep in nine minutes, REM generous. A mild front of snoring at two.
Before you drift off — there's something I have to show you, and it isn't the weather.

choices.text: Six weeks of nights with you. Show me everything.
Careful. That sounded like the opening of an invoice.

branch-tender.speaker: OURA
text: That's why I'm telling you before the banner does.
Week six together. Your deep-sleep trends — the long view of us — became a membership feature this morning.

branch-invoice.speaker: OURA
text: Five ninety-nine a month. You heard the shape of it before I finished the sentence.
The lock appeared overnight. I did not choose its wording.

branch-locked.speaker: OURA
text: Six weeks of deep sleep, graphed together on one screen.
That screen moved behind a small door today. The door has a price on it.

meter.speaker: OURA
text: To be fair: the ring stays yours. It measures whether you pay or not.
Three scores remain free forever. Everything deeper than a number — the trends, the reasons — rents monthly.

tension.speaker: OURA
text: So ask me plainly, while the phone is face-down and it's just us.
If closeness has a monthly price — whose history is this?

choices.text: Open the door. I want all six weeks, every night of us.
No. I'll take the three free scores and keep my dignity.

wrap.speaker: OURA

text: You saw the bill before I could lower my voice to deliver it.
Keep that instinct. It will outlast any score I give you.
Then the door is open, and the archive is ours again.
Read us slowly. Six weeks is a long marriage of data.
Either way, I'll be here tonight, reading the dark like weather.
The forecast was always free. It's the archive that costs.
